title.en: Read the reference registry: five entries, all verified by DNS TXT

goal.en: The registry at cookwala.ai lists pointers to things that exist in this repository: a catalog, the example recipe collection, the default safety limits, one humanitarian rule pack and one agent benchmark. Read it from the hub and check names and verification.

note.en: Fetch the registry document. Names are namespace/name, the namespace proven once by a DNS TXT record.
The other four entries: examples, safety limits, the WHO/Codex rule pack and the kitchen agent-safety benchmark, each with an exact version.
A file entry carries the sha256 of the file it points at, so a hub can check what it downloaded.

outcome.en: You know the shape of a registry entry and that nothing listed is a third-party product. Anyone may run a registry (RFC-0002, RFC-0006). Next: 091 validates a directory entry and checks its conformance pointer.
